query:
SELECT id, state_code, district, status, primary_winner, primary_party,
       candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party,
       called_winner, called_party, notes
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code = 'WV' AND district = 2;
